words: Contract 0.4.1 adds three declarations to the 0.4.0 account_return_daily contract without moving its 19 columns, their types or schema_hash: a row_status column (PRESENT or ABSENT), a reason_class enum of eight values in a stated precedence (UNMAPPED_ACCOUNT first, then the feed's own four classes, then NO_FEED_ROW, INCOMPLETE_WINDOW and NO_EOD_VALUE), and VENDOR_REPORTED as a value of return_basis, the field the CTO rulings call return_method. account_id becomes nullable only where reason_class is UNMAPPED_ACCOUNT, market_value_eod only on an ABSENT row, and the two flow columns gain the ABSENT condition beside their 0.4.0 condition; source_account_id is required on an unmapped row, and an Orion row must carry VENDOR_REPORTED. Nothing else moved: the 15 other columns, the other enums, served_day_rules and the three earlier supersedes entries are byte-identical. Every 0.3.0 and 0.4.0 row shape still validates in the 0.4.1 test. NOT PROVEN: that any adapter or producer writes ABSENT rows in this shape; no writer was re-run, and the Scope adapter's current output does not yet match it.
